description: Keyboard loudness calibration. Each pass rewrites per-pitch hammer_mass (one undo group per pass) and runs for seconds to minutes.

commands.name: calibration.synthesis
commands.title: Calibrate synthesis (offline)
commands.description: Step 2: one-pass offline synthesis calibration, no microphone. Long-running: returns a jobId. velocity is MIDI 1-127 (0 is refused); pitches = list or 'all' (key pitches only).

target_rms.description: Target RMS; default = the saved reference

commands.name: calibration.acoustic
commands.title: Calibrate acoustically (microphone)
commands.description: Step 3: microphone-based acoustic calibration with precision awareness. Long-running: returns a jobId. Needs a selected microphone and a saved reference (or target_rms).

target_rms.description: Target RMS; default = the saved reference

commands.name: calibration.status
commands.title: Calibration status
commands.description: Progress of the running calibration pass (running, progress 0-1, step, message, results).

commands.name: calibration.cancel
commands.title: Cancel calibration
commands.description: Stops the running calibration after the current pitch.
